caption: The drawing depicts a single vertical tree trunk or log, positioned upright in the center of a mostly empty beige or off-white background. The trunk is brown and has several rounded protrusions resembling cut-off branches distributed at irregular intervals along its length. Near the top, the trunk splits into two curved, pointed prongs that arc toward each other and almost form a loop, intersected by a small rounded shape at the apex. At the base of the trunk, there is a patch of green grass surrounding it. The entire composition is enclosed within a faint rectangular border, and the name "RICHARD CORRELL" is written near the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Tree Trunk Hitching Post
